pages.text: 早上，妈妈一边给咘咘梳头一边告诉她：“今天猪猪姐姐要来玩，下午吃冰淇淋，晚上看冰雪奇缘。”咘咘的眼睛一下子亮了，跳起来问：“真的吗？真的吗？猪猪姐姐真的要来吗？”妈妈笑着点点头。
pages.text_en: In the morning, while combing Bubu's hair, Mummy told her, "Today Zhuzhu is coming to play. In the afternoon there will be ice cream, and Frozen in the evening." Bubu's eyes lit up at once, and she jumped up asking, "Really? Really? Is Zhuzhu really coming?" Mummy smiled and nodded.

pages.text: 咘咘在客厅里蹦蹦跳跳，裙子转成了一朵花，心砰砰跳得很快，笑声洒满了整个房间。她大声说：“我好开心！我好开心！”NOMI 在旁边笑着说：“高兴的时候，身体就是想跳起来，根本停不下来呢。”
pages.text_en: Bubu jumped up and down in the living room, her skirt spinning like a flower, her heart beating fast, laughter filling the whole room. She shouted, "I am so happy! I am so happy!" NOMI smiled beside her. "When you are happy, your body just wants to jump. It simply cannot stop."

pages.text: 猪猪姐姐终于来了！咘咘跑过去，拉着猪猪姐姐的手：“猪猪姐姐，我们一起玩！”两个人搭积木、画画、给玩偶办茶话会，还给小熊玩偶盖了被子，玩得舍不得停下来。
pages.text_en: At last Zhuzhu came! Bubu ran over and took Zhuzhu's hand. "Zhuzhu, let's play together!" They built blocks, drew pictures, held a tea party for their dolls, and even tucked a little blanket around the teddy bear, playing so happily they did not want to stop.

pages.text: 玩着玩着，咘咘跑得太快了，差点撞到桌子角，茶杯都晃了一下。妈妈赶紧说：“开心的时候，身体也要慢一点，才玩得安全。”咘咘点点头，放慢了脚步，又拉着猪猪姐姐的手，慢慢走回玩具边。
pages.text_en: While playing, Bubu ran too fast and nearly bumped into the corner of the table, making the teacups wobble. Mummy said quickly, "When you are happy, your body still needs to slow down a little, so play stays safe." Bubu nodded, slowed her steps, took Zhuzhu's hand again, and walked slowly back to the toys.

pages.text: 下午，冰淇淋店到了，门口挂着彩色的招牌，空气里都是甜甜的味道。咘咘拉着爸爸的手指着店门，大声说：“冰淇淋！冰淇淋！”爸爸笑着说：“我们买一个大大的，大家一起分，每个人都有份。”
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, they reached the ice cream shop. A colourful sign hung over the door, and the air smelled sweet. Bubu pulled Daddy's hand and pointed at the door, calling out, "Ice cream! Ice cream!" Daddy smiled. "We will buy one big ice cream and share it with everyone. Everyone gets a share."

pages.text: 妈妈拿出几个小碗，一勺一勺分冰淇淋，粉色的给咘咘，白色的给猪猪姐姐，还有巧克力味的给 NOMI。咘咘捧着自己的小碗，小心地舀了一勺放进嘴里，眯起眼睛说：“好好吃呀，冰冰的，甜甜的！”
pages.text_en: Mummy took out several small bowls and shared the ice cream spoon by spoon, pink for Bubu, white for Zhuzhu, and chocolate for NOMI. Bubu held her own bowl and carefully took a spoonful into her mouth, closing her eyes. "So yummy! Cold and sweet!"

pages.text: 咘咘看着猪猪姐姐吃得开心，眼睛弯弯的，自己也更开心了，好像高兴会传染一样。NOMI 笑着说：“高兴分出去，会变得更多。”NONO 也啄了一口冰淇淋，抬起头叫了一声，像是在附和 NOMI 的话。
pages.text_en: Bubu watched Zhuzhu enjoy her ice cream, eyes curving with happiness, and felt even happier herself, as if happiness could spread. NOMI smiled. "When happiness is shared, it grows bigger." NONO pecked at the ice cream too and chirped, as if agreeing with NOMI.

pages.text: 咘咘吃得太开心了，鼻子上沾了一大坨粉色的冰淇淋，自己还不知道，歪着头看大家为什么都在笑。等她明白过来，也跟着咯咯咯地笑起来，笑声比刚才还要大，冰淇淋的甜味好像都笑出来了。
pages.text_en: Bubu enjoyed her ice cream so much that a big blob of pink ice cream landed on her nose, and she did not even know it, tilting her head to wonder why everyone was laughing. When she understood, she giggled too, louder than before, as if the sweetness of the ice cream had laughed its way out.

pages.text: 晚上，一家人坐下来看冰雪奇缘，客厅的灯调暗了，电视的光照在大家脸上。咘咘靠在妈妈身边，小声跟着哼，心里暖暖的，像出了大太阳，又像抱着一个暖暖的热水袋。
pages.text_en: At night, the family sat down to watch Frozen. The living-room lights were dimmed, and the television light shone on everyone's faces. Bubu leaned against Mummy, humming softly, her heart warm like a big sun, and like holding a warm hot-water bottle.

pages.text: 电影看完了，Coco 拍着手说：“Happy！好开心！”咘咘也掰着手指说：“今天我好开心，因为猪猪姐姐来了，我们一起玩，还分了冰淇淋，看了冰雪奇缘。”她数完，觉得今天的好事多得一只手都数不过来。
pages.text_en: After the movie ended, Coco clapped and said, "Happy!" Bubu counted on her fingers too. "Today I am so happy, because Zhuzhu came, we played together, we shared ice cream, and we watched Frozen." When she finished counting, she felt today's good things were more than she could count on one hand.

pages.text: 妈妈听着咘咘数完，摸摸咘咘的头说：“高兴可以慢慢享受，不用一下子全用完，就像冰淇淋要一口一口吃，才吃得出甜味。”咘咘点点头问：“明天，猪猪姐姐还会再来吗？”妈妈说：“我们可以再约呀。”
pages.text_en: After listening to Bubu count, Mummy patted Bubu's head. "Happiness can be enjoyed slowly. It does not have to be used up all at once, just like ice cream must be eaten bite by bite to taste its sweetness." Bubu nodded and asked, "Tomorrow, will Zhuzhu come again?" Mummy said, "We can plan it again!"

pages.text: 咘咘知道，高兴还会来，就像太阳每天都会升起来一样。下一次，她可以先笑一笑，再慢慢玩，把高兴分给别人，自己也会更开心，因为分出去的高兴一点也不会变少。
pages.text_en: Bubu knew happiness would come again, just as the sun rises every day. Next time, she could smile first, play slowly, share her happiness with others, and feel even happier herself, because happiness shared does not get any smaller.
